record.one_liner: Customer support platform (helpdesk, issues, accounts, knowledge base) for B2B teams, with a REST API and an official MCP server.
record.auth_notes: Public REST API uses a Bearer API token created in Settings > Integrations & dev > API. The official MCP server also accepts OAuth 2.0, but that is for MCP clients, not the public REST API.
record.access_notes: Token creation is self-serve for Admins. The fetched pages do not state a plan gate for API access, and free-plan status was not verified on a pricing page, so this value is provisional.
record.api_notes: Regional base URLs (US api.usepylon.com, EU api.eu.usepylon.com). Reference covers accounts, knowledge bases, custom fields, tags, me and other objects with read and write endpoints.
record.blocker_notes: Admin-created API token plus documented REST API and an official MCP server. Plan gating is unverified, which is why confidence is low.
